candidate.definition_en: A musical instrument with four strings held against the neck and played with a bow.
candidate.explanation_ar: آلة موسيقية وترية بتتلعب بقوس، صوتها ناعم ومشهورة جداً في الموسيقى الكلاسيكية والأوركسترا.

senses.definition_en: A musical instrument with four strings held against the neck and played with a bow.
senses.explanation_ar: آلة الكمان؛ آلة موسيقية وترية تعزف بالقوس.
examples: She plays the violin very well.
I want to buy a new violin for my lesson.
The sound of a violin can be very sad.
